ING-001-street-crosswalk-back.why: Photoreal wet street; two separate whiskey-tan straps each through its own brass staple with its own gold clasp, small brass tongue at center, heavy creasing. v2 has a dark low-contrast left belt and a flipped-out strap end; v3 center hardware is messier.

ING-002-street-crook-elbow.why: Cleanest two-clasp front with contrasting tan straps, small center tongue, natural crook-of-elbow carry, no face. v2 has a flipped-up strap tip at the right staple and cluttered center hardware; v3 carry physics are ambiguous (handles upright, arm not clearly through them).

ING-003-street-coffee-run.why: Crisp sunlit photoreal, two tan straps with separate gold clasps and small tongue, natural hand on blank cup. v2 turn-lock tongue is a malformed squiggle; v3 has a stray floating brass keeper on the right strap.

ING-004-street-brownstone-steps.why: Warm believable brownstone light, symmetric two-strap two-clasp hardware, tan piping, natural hand. v2 tongue is a squiggly mutated hook; v3 right strap sags diagonally with a stray brass tab on the gusset.

ING-005-street-leaf-path.why: All three show the fused-strap mutation: one continuous black belt feeding a single oversized central diamond turn-lock plate. No two separate angled clasp plates as required, so every variant fails product truth despite good photoreal.

ING-006-street-two-hand-front.why: Both hands natural, two separate contrasting tan straps each with its own gold clasp, small brass loop tongue, brass-only hardware, heavy creasing. v2 has a flipped-up strap end at the right staple; v3 rear handle texture is mutated (scaly) and a chin sliver enters frame.

ING-007-street-bookstore-door.why: All three render the wrong front: a single belt with one oversized central Kelly-style lock (fused-strap mutation) plus invented braided brogue trim along the top edge. No two clasp plates, no small center turn lock in any variant.

ING-008-street-market-stall.why: Same cognac mutation in all three: one continuous strap into a single central Kelly-style clasp with invented brogue-braid edge trim, instead of two separate straps with their own angled gold clasps and a small center turn lock.

ING-009-street-phone-check.why: All three black variants show a single continuous belt fused into one wide central diamond-lock plate; the two separate angled clasp plates are missing. v3 additionally has a gray discolored strap tab. Every variant fails product truth.

ING-010-street-evening-lamplight.why: All three repeat the black-colorway mutation: one strap plus a single oversized central diamond turn-lock plate, no separate clasp plates. Photoreal is fine but product truth fails in every variant.
